findings.report: F fresh Bridge C-08 sparse holdout
findings.smallest_governable_scope: Narrow-width height/overflow sizing of the decision/risk and metric component bodies, plus vertical visibility/discoverability of evidence table rows.
findings.observed: At 390 px, DecisionRiskEngine body scrollHeight is 171 and clientHeight 106 (65 px clipped). MetricEngine body scrollHeight 75 and clientHeight 46 (29 px clipped). The rationale is cut after a few lines; metric delta and target are below the visible body. Full scene shows one of three table rows, with horizontal scroll prompt and keyboard/swipe hints but no vertical affordance. The Span 4 “Not synced / Open” row is not visible. Document/body width is 390 and no horizontal spill occurs.
findings.task_consequence: The reader can see 2/3 but not the missing check explanation, target/delta or open Span 4 row that controls reopening; safety decision context is materially weakened.
findings.other_scenes: A–E at 390 and B/D at 320 inspected. B/C/D horizontal tables expose arrow/end/swipe cues; 98.6% and 94.2% comparison remains intact at 390/320; B/D process flow is readable and recomposes. No heading/content collision observed in six narrow scenes.

findings.status: confirmed in editable PPTX package; preview raster also observed via Quick Look
findings.smallest_governable_scope: PPTX export mapping for source chart type, series/category identity and value-axis scale.
findings.observed: Editable PPTX packages contain the benchmark headlines, KPI/comparison, narrative, decision/risk and next-step text as extractable text shapes; table cells are present. But source Box Plots in B/C export as LINE_MARKERS; C weekly control/treatment values export as one series over repeated W1–W4 categories, and the outcome distribution also becomes a line. A–D numeric trend charts rasterize against broad 0–200/0–20 axes in Quick Look, flattening visible variation; no explicit value-axis min/max is encoded in chart XML. Chart type/series findings are package facts independent of Quick Look.
findings.task_consequence: A reader opening the deck can read the narrative but misread distribution shape, treatment/control trend, or magnitude; text presence does not preserve decision evidence.
findings.renderer_limit: No qualified headless PowerPoint/LibreOffice renderer was available. Keynote 13.2 was installed but automated open stalled. Actual qlmanage Quick Look renders are retained, labeled, and treated as preview evidence rather than Office-engine certification.
